column1: # Partition table for builds WITHOUT ESP-SR (no speech recognition)
# No "model" partition — all available space goes to LittleFS
# Factory: 5332K  (grown 2026-06-06 from 4948K to fit the BT + G2 glasses /
#          Bluetooth build
#          NOTE: this no longer matches partitions_sr_8mb.csv's 4992K factory
#          — the BT+G2 binary is too large for the SR layout anyway
#          "same binary fits either layout" invariant no longer applies here.)
# LittleFS: 2796K (shrunk from 3180K to give the factory partition room.
#          Moving the littlefs offset (0x4E5000 → 0x545000) reformats it:
#          on-device files are WIPED on the first flash after this change.
#          NVS (0x9000) is unaffected
# Flash-encryption prep (2026-07-30): nvs moved to 0xA000 and shrunk 24K->16K
# to make room for BOTH a 4K nvs_key partition (XTS keys for NVS encryption
# mandatory in any CONFIG_SECURE_FLASH_ENC_ENABLED build) AND a partition
# table at 0x9000 - the FE-enabled bootloader is ~33K
# 0x8000 table allows
# CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET=0x9000. Plain boards keep the table at 0x8000
# and simply leave 0x8000-0xA000 slack; the same CSV serves both offsets.
